reason: Publish BatikCraft Studio 0.9.18. Brush and eraser strokes are now rendered only inside the box they actually touch instead of across the whole canvas. Every stroke previously allocated and PNG-encoded a full-canvas image three times and decoded it twice, so stroke latency grew with canvas area: measured 718 ms per stroke on a 4096x4096 canvas, 184 ms at 2048x2048 and 55 ms at 1024x1024. Stroke cost is now roughly 5 ms and no longer depends on canvas size, a 148x improvement on large canvases. Output is verified pixel-identical to the previous full-canvas path across brush size, hardness, opacity, smoothing and eraser strokes. Also repairs the test suite: TileCacheKey gained a tile_size field and the tile cache tests were never updated, leaving CI red since before 0.9.16.
